description: Source code for the OpenCDMSystemPrivate class implementation, managing DRM system interactions including session creation, key store management, and DRM time retrieval.

classes.name: OpenCDMSystemPrivate
classes.description: Implementation class managing DRM system interactions, including session management and key store operations.

methods.name: keySystem
methods.description: Returns the key system identifier string.

methods.name: metadata
methods.description: Returns the metadata string associated with the DRM system.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new DRM session with specified license type, callbacks, and initialization data.

methods.name: getDrmTime
methods.description: Retrieves the current DRM time from the backend.

methods.name: getLdlSessionsLimit
methods.description: Retrieves the limit on the number of LDL sessions.

methods.name: getKeyStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the key store.

methods.name: getDrmStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the DRM store.
